question.text: What cumulative measles death toll (confirmed + suspected) will Bangladesh's DGHS report for 12 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the cumulative combined measles death toll reported by Bangladesh's Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) in its daily measles bulletin covering the 24 hours ending 08:00 Bangladesh Standard Time (UTC+6) on 12 November 2026. The value is the cumulative total of measles-related deaths since 15 March 2026 stated in that bulletin — laboratory-confirmed measles deaths plus deaths among people with measles-like symptoms (suspected measles deaths) — not the number of new deaths reported for that 24-hour period. The figure is taken from The Business Standard's report of that bulletin, whose headline toll figure is the value to use, listed at https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health; if The Business Standard does not report that bulletin, the cumulative total stated for 12 November 2026 is taken from other [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions). Example: if the bulletin reports 1,318 cumulative confirmed-plus-suspected measles deaths, the question resolves to 1318.
question.fine_print: If DGHS publishes no bulletin covering the 24 hours ending 08:00 BST on 12 November 2026, the question resolves using the cumulative total in the next DGHS measles bulletin published before 19 November 2026; if no DGHS measles bulletin is published between 12 and 19 November 2026, the question is annulled.

# Bangladesh measles deaths (DGHS): research notes as of 2026-11-02

**Bottom line:** The latest toll is 1,254, from the 1 November bulletin. New deaths have slowed sharply in the last three bulletins, to about 1.7 a day, after a run of about 5 a day the week before. That is well below the 4-6 a day the question background assumes.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: The TBS health page lists the newest headline as "Measles death toll rises to 1,254, with 2 more children dying in 24 hours". The ones before it are 1,252, 1,251 and 1,249. [TBS health](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health)
- 2026-11-01: The TBS report of the DGHS bulletin for the 24 hours to 08:00 on 1 November gives:
  - deaths: 1,254 in total, of which 1,149 suspected and 105 lab-confirmed, with 2 new deaths;
  - cases: 1,353 new suspected cases, 230,013 suspected in total, and 64 new confirmed cases, 23,935 confirmed in total;
  - 204,783 people hospitalised since 15 March. [TBS](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health/measles-death-toll-reaches-1254-2-more-children-die-24hrs-1589366)
- I could not find the 2 November bulletin. It usually comes out around 15:30 BST, which is about 09:30 UTC.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The resolving bulletin, for 12 November, is 11 bulletins after the latest one.
- The 2 new deaths on 1 November were both suspected; the confirmed count stayed at 105. One was in Sylhet division and one in Chittagong. [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423455/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-1-254-as-two), [UNB](https://unb.com.bd/category/Bangladesh/2-more-children-die-with-measles-like-symptoms/199278)
- Background says cumulative cases passed 250,000. That probably means suspected plus confirmed (230,013 + 23,935 is about 254,000).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-01: Toll reaches 1,254 (+2). [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423455/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-1-254-as-two)
- 2026-10-31 to 11-01: Reuters-based reports on dengue mention measles deaths "exceeding 1,200". Dengue had its worst month of 2026 in October, with 173 deaths and 418 for the year, adding to pressure on hospitals. [UrduPoint](https://www.urdupoint.com/en/middle-east/dengue-fever-claims-418-lives-in-bangladesh-a-2281119.html)
- 2026-10-31: Toll 1,252 (+1), per the TBS headline list. [TBS health](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health)
- 2026-10-30: Toll 1,251 (+2). [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423299/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-1-251-as-two)
- 2026-10-29: Toll 1,249 (+7). [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423195/measles-outbreak-death-toll-reaches-1-249-as)
- 2026-10-28: Toll 1,242 (+2). [UNB](https://unb.com.bd/category/Bangladesh/2-more-children-die-with-measles-like-symptoms-death-toll-stands-at-1242/198963)
- 2026-10-27: Toll 1,240. [TBS](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/measles-death-toll-reaches-1240-6-more-children-die-1584401) gives +6 and [Dhaka Tribune](https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/423026/measles-seven-more-die-in-bangladesh) gives +7. The two outlets sometimes give slightly different daily counts.
- 2026-11 (CDC EID journal, November issue): a review article, "Lessons Learned from Measles Resurgence, Bangladesh, 2026". [CDC EID](https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/26-1019_article)

## 4. Base rates and trend
These are my own calculations from the reported tolls:

| Period | Change | Average per day |
|---|---|---|
| 5 Oct (1,122) to 11 Oct (1,162) | +40 | about 6.7 |
| 11 Oct (1,162) to 1 Nov (1,254) | +92 | about 4.4 |
| 23 Oct (1,214) to 30 Oct (1,251) | +37 | about 5.3 |
| 29 Oct (1,249) to 1 Nov (1,254) | +5 | about 1.7 |

- Daily increments over the last two weeks ranged from 1 to 7. Low-count days often come in clusters, and big days (+7) can follow them, so three days is a short window to judge a slowdown.
- The 1 November bulletin is 11 days before the 12 November bulletin. Carrying recent rates forward gives:

| Assumed pace | Projected 12 Nov toll |
|---|---|
| 1.7 a day | about 1,273 |
| 3 a day | about 1,287 |
| 4.4 a day | about 1,302 |
| 5.3 a day | about 1,312 |

- Deaths are slowing even though new suspected cases are not: about 1,350 a day are still being reported (1,353 on 1 November).
- DGHS has revised its counts before. The Daily Star once reported a revised total of 409, an earlier downward revision. [Daily Star](https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/measles-death-toll-now-409-after-revision-4172706)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market or expert forecast on Bangladesh's measles deaths.
- The Kalshi and Polymarket measles markets supplied with the question are about US case counts. They do not bear on this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Ten more daily bulletins, 2 to 11 November, before the resolving one on 12 November. Each usually appears around 15:30 BST.
- A possible new WHO SEARO epidemiological bulletin, which could signal a trend.
- Any DGHS reclassification or revision of death counts.
- The impact of the MR vaccination campaign (21.0 million doses given as of 18 October), and the dengue load on hospitals.
- If the 12 November bulletin is missing, the question uses the next bulletin published before 19 November.

## Bangladesh measles death toll: research for the 12 November 2026 bulletin

The latest bulletin I found puts the cumulative toll at **1,254 as of 08:00 on 1 November**. The pace has slowed sharply: only +5 deaths over the last three bulletins, against roughly 5 a day in October. The 12 November bulletin is 11 bulletin-days away.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: The TBS health page shows these measles headlines, newest first: 1,254 (+2), 1,252 (+1), 1,251 (+2), 1,249 (+7). [TBS health](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health)
- 2026-11-01: The bulletin for the 24 hours to 08:00 on 1 Nov reported 2 new deaths (Sylhet and Chattogram divisions). The cumulative toll is **1,254**: 1,149 suspected and 105 lab-confirmed. [TBS](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health/measles-death-toll-reaches-1254-2-more-children-die-24hrs-1589366); confirmed by [Observer](https://observerbd.com/news/603195) and [Financial Express](https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/national/two-more-children-die-with-measles-like-symptoms)
- I could not find a 2 Nov bulletin yet. These usually come out in the Bangladesh afternoon, which is around the forecast close.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The toll is 1,254, which is 34.5 deaths above the bottom of the question's range (1,219.5).
- The lab-confirmed count has stayed at 105 since at least 29 Oct. All recent deaths are in the suspected category.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-01: The bulletin reported 1,353 new suspected cases and 64 new confirmed cases. Cumulative totals are 230,013 suspected and 23,935 confirmed. There have been 204,783 hospitalisations since 15 March, with 196,183 recovered. [TBS](https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health/measles-death-toll-reaches-1254-2-more-children-die-24hrs-1589366)

  - Case inflow (about 1,350 a day) shows no decline, even though deaths have slowed.

### 4. Base rates and trend
- 2026-10-05: Toll 1,122. [Capital FM](https://capitalfm.africa/bangladesh-measles-outbreak-death-toll-rises-to-1122/)

### 5. Other forecasts
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets provided cover Bangladesh; they all concern US measles counts or unrelated topics.
- I found no Metaculus community forecast or expert projection of Bangladesh's death toll.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Daily DGHS bulletins on 2-12 Nov (11 more).

- High: a backlog of reclassified or late-reported deaths is added, or the high October case load produces a lagged rise in deaths to 7 to 8 a day. Either could push the toll to 1,320 to 1,340 or more.
